title: Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another
abstract: arXiv:2610.16141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them us

translated_title: 幻影合并：当你的大语言模型智能体选了一个实体，却告诉你另一个
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在多个实体上运行，可靠的响应生成不仅需要检索相关证据，还需要保持证据与正确实体之间的关联。我们识别出一种名为“幻影合并”（Phantom Merge, PM）的实体-证据绑定失败现象，即智能体将缺乏依据的论断归因于其已承诺的实体，甚至可能在任务已正确完成的情况下发生。我们在论断层面对PM进行了形式化定义，并在四个智能体领域和四个骨干模型家族中刻画了该现象的普遍程度与错误子类型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个用于论断级风险估计与修正的两阶段框架。第一阶段，锚点接地风险估计（Anchor-Grounded Risk, AGR）将智能体输出前隐藏状态的表征读出与基于雅可比矩阵的功能信息相结合，提供互补的槽位级与锚点-值风险评分。第二阶段，固定锚点修正（Fixed-Anchor Correction, FAC）对被标记的论断进行审计并选择性地加以修正。
tldr: 该论文首次识别并形式化了LLM智能体中的“幻影合并”实体-证据绑定失败问题，并提出结合锚点接地风险估计与固定锚点修正的两阶段框架，用于检测和修正被错误归因于实体的论断。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and formalizes Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in LLM agents, and proposes a two-stage framework combining Anchor-Grounded Risk estimation and Fixed-Anchor Correction to detect and selectively revise claims wrongly attributed to entities.
